label: Education Content Dub After Picture V1
description: 교육 콘텐츠 전용 포맷. 오프닝/엔딩의 승인된 대사는 재사용하고, Malmoelab 예문 길이 기준으로 TTS 예상 시간을 먼저 계산해 씬 길이를 잡은 뒤, 무음 picture lock을 완성하고, 더빙과 칠판 타이포를 후반에서 합성한다.

runnerHints.durationPrepass: estimate TTS duration from the Malmoelab example sentence before scene generation
runnerHints.pictureStage: generate mute scenes first and assemble picture lock before any dubbing
runnerHints.dubStage: reuse approved opening/ending dialogue assets, synthesize content-only lines, then build dub lock
runnerHints.typeStage: apply chalkboard typography only after dub lock

voiceConfigPolicy.rule: voice-slots may override ttsVoiceEnv, otherwise the renderer resolves the default voice env from the character voice config

sceneGenerationPolicy.timingRule: scene lengths are set after measuring content-line TTS duration plus presentation margin
sceneGenerationPolicy.pictureLockRequirement: all scenes must be assembled as mute video before dubbing
sceneGenerationPolicy.defaultCompositionRule: teacher on right quarter, clean chalkboard on left three-quarters
